items.title: @rohanpaul_ai：New Alibaba ByteDance paper shows that AI agents can no longer be served like ordinary LLM requests. Because most of the
items.abstract_or_text: New Alibaba ByteDance paper shows that AI agents can no longer be served like ordinary LLM requests. Because most of the performance problem now sits across tools, memory, environments, and the model together. This paper builds AgentSysBench around 10 agentic applications and finds that model inference is often no longer the main bottleneck. They find task-aware serving cuts latency by 29–40%, communication-aware placement delivers up to a 4.5× speedup, state offloading cuts memory by 4.6×, and caching removes 35.2% of redundant search calls. – arxiv.org/abs/2608.15127 Title: "From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems"
items.summary_zh: 帖文转述一篇阿里巴巴与字节跳动论文：研究以 10 个智能体应用构成 AgentSysBench，认为智能体服务的性能瓶颈常跨越工具、记忆、环境和模型，且不一定主要来自模型推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这为智能体系统的性能优化提供了可量化的工程问题框架，值得关注论文对工作负载和指标的完整定义。
items.abstract_zh: 一篇来自阿里巴巴与字节跳动的新论文显示，AI 智能体已无法按普通 LLM 请求提供服务，因为如今大部分性能问题横跨工具、记忆、环境与模型。该论文围绕 10 个智能体应用构建 AgentSysBench，发现模型推理往往不再是主要瓶颈。论文称，任务感知服务可将延迟降低 29–40%，通信感知放置最高带来 4.5 倍加速，状态卸载可将内存用量降低 4.6 倍，缓存消除了 35.2% 的冗余搜索调用。— arxiv.org/abs/2608.15127，题目为《From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems》。

items.title: @fchollet：This is very nice work from NVIDIA. Like all high-performing approaches on ARC-AGI-3, it uses deep learning-guided on-th
items.abstract_or_text: This is very nice work from NVIDIA. Like all high-performing approaches on ARC-AGI-3, it uses deep learning-guided on-the-fly synthesis of symbolic world models, i.e. navigating the world by generating programs to represent what you know. To be clear, like with several other recent claims, scoring 100% on the public demonstration set is not the same as "scoring 100% on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark". It would be like saying you beat a videogame because you cleared the tutorial level.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 评价 NVIDIA 的 ARC-AGI-3 方案，并指出其采用深度学习引导的即时符号世界模型合成。作者特别认为，公开演示集的满分不能等同于完整 ARC-AGI-3 基准的满分。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这条评论直接提示了基准宣传中演示集与完整评测的差异，有助于读者审慎理解性能声明。
items.abstract_zh: 这是 NVIDIA 很好的工作。与 ARC-AGI-3 上所有高性能方法一样，它采用由深度学习引导的即时符号世界模型合成，即通过生成程序表示已知内容来探索世界。需要澄清的是，和近期若干说法一样，在公开演示集上获得 100% 并不等于“在 ARC-AGI-3 基准上得到 100%”。这好比因为通关教程关就声称打通了一款电子游戏。

items.title: @EinsiaAI：1/ Recursive self-improvement (RSI) depends on agents improving how AI systems are trained —not just tuning hyperparamet
items.abstract_or_text: 1/ Recursive self-improvement (RSI) depends on agents improving how AI systems are trained —not just tuning hyperparameters, but improving the training algorithm itself. We tested this directly with AI4AI-Bench: 10 real research repositories spanning 10 distinct algorithm families. Full breakdown 👇 GitHub: [https://t.co/s0f0NY7PdQ] Paper Link: [https://t.co/x0qY8wnlwB] Einsia Website:[https://t.co/Rewt4FJwl8] 📊 The results: The average score is just 0.166. Even the best-performing model, Opus 5, reaches only 0.288. The median exploration cost per task rises from 1.69 to 34.60. #AI4AI #RecursiveSelfImprovement #AIResearch #AI4AI_Bench
items.summary_zh: Einsia 发布 AI4AI-Bench，称其覆盖 10 个算法家族的 10 个真实研究代码库，用于直接测试智能体改进训练算法的能力；帖文报告当前模型得分仍较低。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：若基准任务与评测实现可复查，它能把“递归自我改进”的宏观讨论转化为可检验的研究能力测量。
items.abstract_zh: 1/ 递归自我改进（RSI）取决于智能体改进 AI 系统的训练方式——不只是调节超参数，还包括改进训练算法本身。我们用 AI4AI-Bench 直接测试了这一点：涵盖 10 个不同算法家族的 10 个真实研究代码库。完整介绍见下方。GitHub：[https://t.co/s0f0NY7PdQ]；论文链接：[https://t.co/x0qY8wnlwB]；Einsia 网站：[https://t.co/Rewt4FJwl8]。📊 结果：平均分仅为 0.166。即使表现最好的模型 Opus 5，得分也只有 0.288。每项任务的探索成本中位数从 1.69 上升至 34.60。#AI4AI #RecursiveSelfImprovement #AIResearch #AI4AI_Bench

items.title: @GoogleDeepMind：Games have been an important testbed for our AI research for over 15 years. 🎮 From mastering Atari to reaching Grandmast
items.abstract_or_text: Games have been an important testbed for our AI research for over 15 years. 🎮 From mastering Atari to reaching Grandmaster in StarCraft II, they have driven some of our biggest AI breakthroughs. Our work with SIMA taught agents how to understand 3D worlds, but learning to navigate real human dynamics takes a living, persistent universe. Through our research partnership with @FenrisCreations, we’re exploring how to tackle open challenges in AI: 🔵 Continual learning to acquire new skills without forgetting past knowledge. 🔵 Deep memory systems that store and retrieve information far beyond today’s context windows. 🔵 Long-horizon planning over weeks, months, or years. 🔵 Multi-agent dynamics spanning cooperation, negotiation, economics, and emergent behaviors. Our long-term goal is to use AI to discover entirely new gameplay experiences in partnership with game developers – making games more accessible and personalized – while applying what we've learned to problems in the real world and scientific discovery. Find out more →
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布与 Fenris Creations 开展研究合作，以持续运行的游戏世界探索持续学习、深度记忆、长时程规划和多智能体互动等问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：游戏环境在这里被作为研究载体；合作的研究价值将取决于后续公开的方法、任务设计和结果，而非公告本身。
items.abstract_zh: 15 年多来，游戏一直是我们 AI 研究的重要试验场。🎮 从掌握 Atari 到在《星际争霸 II》中达到大师级水平，它们推动了我们最重要的一些 AI 突破。我们与 SIMA 的工作教会智能体理解 3D 世界，但学习如何驾驭真实的人类互动需要一个鲜活而持续存在的宇宙。通过与 @FenrisCreations 的研究合作，我们正在探索如何应对 AI 中的开放挑战：🔵 持续学习，在不遗忘既有技能的同时获得新技能。🔵 深度记忆系统，存储和检索远超当今上下文窗口的信息。🔵 跨越数周、数月或数年的长时程规划。🔵 涉及合作、谈判、经济与涌现行为的多智能体动态。我们的长期目标是与游戏开发者合作，利用 AI 发现全新的游戏体验，使游戏更易接近且更具个性化，同时把所学应用到现实世界的问题和科学发现中。了解更多 →

items.title: @YongchaoC：I kept wondering: every AI benchmark tests whether models can follow a roadmap humans drew. What if we take the roadmap
items.abstract_or_text: I kept wondering: every AI benchmark tests whether models can follow a roadmap humans drew. What if we take the roadmap away?For many research-heavy tasks, how well does current LLM work? We built ASI-Bench to find out. 60 research tasks, 11 fields. Best agent scores 51.60 without human guidance. Open for contributions.
items.summary_zh: YongchaoC 介绍 ASI-Bench：该基准覆盖 11 个领域的 60 项研究型任务，旨在衡量缺少人类路线指引时 LLM 的工作表现；帖文称最佳智能体得分为 51.60。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：该设问把评测重点从遵循既定步骤转向自主研究过程，若任务与评分细则公开，将有助于检验这一主张。
items.abstract_zh: 我一直在想：每个 AI 基准都测试模型能否遵循人类画出的路线图。如果把路线图拿走会怎样？对于许多研究密集型任务，当前 LLM 的表现如何？我们构建了 ASI-Bench 来寻找答案。它包含 11 个领域的 60 项研究任务。在没有人类指导时，最佳智能体得分为 51.60。欢迎参与贡献。

items.abstract_or_text: A harness turns a model into an agent. At it’s core it provides 4 things: - a system prompt - tools - an agentic loop - a translation layer across models New blog post from Earendil co-founder @colindaymond on what a harness is, and how you can own yours. Full post below
